WITH goalie_game AS (
  SELECT
    game_id,
    goalie_id,
    team_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(shots, 0)::int) AS shots,
    SUM(COALESCE(saves, 0)::int) AS saves
  FROM public.game_event
  WHERE team_id = 1
  GROUP BY game_id, goalie_id, team_id
)
SELECT
  TRIM(p.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(p.last_name, '')) AS goalie_name,
  COUNT(*) AS "GP",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE (gm.home_team_id = gg.team_id AND gm.home_score > gm.away_score)
       OR (gm.away_team_id = gg.team_id AND gm.away_score > gm.home_score)
  ) AS "W",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE (gm.home_team_id = gg.team_id AND gm.home_score < gm.away_score)
       OR (gm.away_team_id = gg.team_id AND gm.away_score < gm.home_score)
  ) AS "L",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (
    WHERE gm.home_score = gm.away_score
  ) AS "T",
  SUM(gg.shots - gg.saves) AS "GA",
  SUM(gg.shots) AS "Sh",
  SUM(gg.saves) AS "Sv",
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(gg.shots) > 0
      THEN ROUND(SUM(gg.saves)::numeric / SUM(gg.shots), 3)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "SvPct"
FROM goalie_game gg
JOIN public.players p
  ON p.player_id = gg.goalie_id
JOIN public.game gm
  ON gm.game_id = gg.game_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.first_name, p.last_name
HAVING SUM(gg.shots) > 0
   AND SUM(gg.saves) > 0
ORDER BY "SvPct" DESC NULLS LAST, "Sh" DESC;
